subject.title: feat(skills): publish large bundles via staged upload

question: Should ClawHub add this public staged skill upload API once the staged-bundle availability guard and real large-bundle publish proof are in place?
rationale: The implementation direction matches the package upload-ticket precedent, but it introduces a new public skill publish wire protocol whose operational behavior and API shape need maintainer acceptance after the concrete safety blocker is fixed.

options.title: Fix and review for merge
options.body: Require bounded staged bundle parsing, focused tests, removal of the changelog edit, and redacted real publish proof before considering this API surface mergeable.

options.title: Pause the API surface
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want to add a skill upload-ticket route yet or want a different request shape.

recommendation.title: Fix and review for merge
recommendation.body: Require bounded staged bundle parsing, focused tests, removal of the changelog edit, and redacted real publish proof before considering this API surface mergeable.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the requested reviewer and has recent adjacent history in staged/prepublication publishing.
